$comment: A BARE BLOCK-SCOPE FUNCTION DECLARATION HAS ITS BLOCK'S SCOPE AND `extern`'S LINKAGE (C 6.2.1p4, 6.2.2p5; P69 round 1, lane cs, fold f26b). MEASURED by lane lm's probes k9h and k9i (gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3, gnu2x and c2x -pedantic-errors, built and run): `int x = 1; { int x(void); return x() + 0 * 1; }` with a file-scope `int x(void) { return 42; }` runs 42 on all four, and `{ char T(int); return sizeof ((T)(2)) == 1 ? 42 : 1; }` under a file-scope `typedef int T;` runs 42 on all four (sizeof's operand is not evaluated, so `T` needs no definition, C 6.9p5). Before this fold the declaration was re-homed onto the FILE scope: the block held no binding, so the enclosing object and the typedef stayed visible inside it. Every return before 42 names the first fact that failed. The release arm pins that the optimizer keeps the call the file-scope function's.
